schema.description: Represents an AWS Backup recovery point, which is a point-in-time snapshot of a resource that has been backed up.

BackupSizeInBytes.description: The size of the backup in bytes.

BackupVaultArn.description: The ARN of the backup vault that contains the recovery point.

BackupVaultName.description: The name of the backup vault that contains the recovery point.

CalculatedLifecycle.description: The calculated lifecycle properties of the recovery point.

DeleteAt.description: The date and time when the recovery point will be deleted.

MoveToColdStorageAt.description: The date and time when the recovery point will be moved to cold storage.

CompletionDate.description: The date and time that the recovery point was completed.

CompositeMemberIdentifier.description: The composite member identifier for the recovery point.

CreationDate.description: The date and time that a recovery point is created.

EncryptionKeyArn.description: The encryption key used to protect the recovery point.

IamRoleArn.description: The IAM role ARN used to create the recovery point.

InitiationDate.description: The date and time that a backup job or copy job was initiated.

IsEncrypted.description: Whether the recovery point is encrypted.

IsParent.description: Whether the recovery point is a parent recovery point.

LastRestoreTime.description: The date and time that a recovery point was last restored.

Lifecycle.description: The lifecycle defines when a protected resource is transitioned to cold storage and when it expires.

DeleteAfterDays.description: The number of days after creation that a recovery point is deleted.

DeleteAfterEvent.description: The event that triggers the deletion of the recovery point.

MoveToColdStorageAfterDays.description: The number of days after creation that a recovery point is moved to cold storage.

OptInToArchiveForSupportedResources.description: Whether to opt in to archive for supported resources.

ParentRecoveryPointArn.description: The ARN of the parent recovery point.

RecoveryPointArn.description: The ARN of the recovery point.

ResourceArn.description: The ARN of the resource that was backed up.

ResourceName.description: The name of the resource that was backed up.

ResourceType.description: The type of AWS resource that was backed up.

SourceBackupVaultArn.description: The ARN of the source backup vault for copied recovery points.

Status.description: The status of the recovery point.

StorageClass.description: The storage class of the recovery point.

VaultType.description: The type of vault in which the recovery point resides.
